slides.texte_overlay:
habits that will make you
unreasonably confident

arriving early

get everywhere 10 minutes early for a month and just stand there, no phone. owning a space before anyone else arrives changes how you carry yourself once they do.

the money question

once a week, ask one money question you've always been too shy to ask: a discount, a raise, a refund. most of what you never got, you simply never asked for.

slow replies

wait at least an hour before answering any message that isn't urgent. being available every second tells your brain that your time belongs to everyone else.

daily curiosity

spend 5 minutes a day reading about something new: a painting, a lost civilization, how stars are born. curious people are rarely nervous in conversations, they're too busy being interested.
slides.texte_sophia:
daily curiosity

spend 5 minutes a day on something completely new: a painting, a lost civilization, how stars are born. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and curious people are rarely nervous in conversations.

slides.texte_overlay:
hard talks first

when something needs to be said, say it within 24 hours. every day you delay a hard conversation it gets heavier, and saying it early proves to you that you can handle it.
